overall.reasons: I opened all 72 images (24 poses, each with BEFORE, AFTER and UNREAL). The warm emissive lobe is gone from every spheres, exterior and backlit pose. The shadowed floor now reads as dark umbra, as UNREAL's does. The tan cube beside the mirror sphere is now dark in the sun04 and sun15 poses, and the sun60 halo ring is gone. Backlit faces are a little darker and cooler, closer to UNREAL. Interior walls are marginally darker, which the criteria allow. I saw no acne, banding, leaks or flicker, and shadow edges are as soft as before and as UNREAL's. There is no REGRESSION in any frame. Remaining gaps against UNREAL are not caused by this change. UNREAL's interiors carry sky fill that the engine renders as near-black. This is worst in the sun60 interiors, which stay FAR. UNREAL's mirror-sphere reflections and floor browns also differ.
